answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Gilgal beyond its location: the twelve stones, the naming, and Saul made king.

clauses.english: was where Israel set up twelve stones taken from the Jordan
was where the LORD rolled away the reproach of Egypt from Israel
clauses.quote: This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you.

clauses.english: was where Saul was made king before the LORD
clauses.quote: there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal

doubts: Some marked verses (JDG 3:19, 1SA 13, 1SA 15, HOS, AMO, MIC 6:5) may concern a different Gilgal or give no clear event; they were left out, as was 1SA 11:15's identity with the Jordan Gilgal being only assumed.
